summary: Judge murdered by the 'Ndrangheta; same-surname figure from the comune next to San Mango d'Aquino, no proven kinship.
bio: Born in Conflenti, next to San Mango d'Aquino. Investigating judge and later appeals-court president; murdered by the 'Ndrangheta in Lamezia Terme in 1975; commemorated by President Mattarella. Ferlaino is a small Savuto-valley surname, so a distant link is plausible but unproven.
